correctness.rationale: The special cubic has sole singular point [1:1:1:1:1], an ordinary double point since tangent Hessian 3(I3+11^T) is nondegenerate modulo 5. Any line avoiding the node is rigid; lines through it correspond to finitely many tangent directions at intersection of a smooth conic and a cubic, ensuring finite special Fano fiber. The universal four coefficient equations in the regular 4-dimensional relative Grassmannian are local complete intersection, so the finite relative scheme is Cohen–Macaulay, flat over the DVR and generic rank 27. Fifteen rational pairing lines and twelve cyclotomic generic lines descending to six ramified quadratic K=Q5(sqrt5) points are explicit. Reduction gives 15 avoiding-node lines and exactly six node lines, each tangent dimension >=1; total length 27 forces respective lengths 1 and 2. Normalized Plücker p02/p01=t generates the nilpotent at each double point modulo 5, yielding the local algebra map; Nakayama upgrades the disjoint union to an integral isomorphism. Independent exact enumeration of all 806 two-planes over F5 found 21 F5-rational lines, six through the node, consistent with—not proving—geometric flatness.
